tasks.title: Normalize Stable buffering pattern across all ChemistryEngine tiers
tasks.description: ChemistryEngine has inconsistent Stable buffering: Adjacent and SameBag tiers use a skip pattern (if stableBuffer > rule.Threshold, continue -- skips the entire reaction check, doesn't raise the threshold), while WholeInventory uses the correct additive pattern (effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer). The skip pattern is wrong: Stable should raise the effective threshold, not act as a binary skip. Example: if threshold=2, stableBuffer=1, count=3, the skip pattern would NOT skip (1 < 2) and reaction fires at count=3 vs threshold=2. The additive pattern correctly makes effectiveThreshold=3, so count=3 would NOT fire. Fix: Normalize all three tiers to use effectiveThreshold = rule.Threshold + stableBuffer, then compare the computed count/magnitude against effectiveThreshold. Update unit tests to verify boundary behavior: stableBuffer raises threshold by exact magnitude, stableBuffer=0 has no effect, stableBuffer equal to count prevents reaction.

tasks.title: Implement Volatile net-hot calculation
tasks.description: Replace the current simple Hot+Volatile pair-trigger explosion with the net-hot system from docs/chemistry-system.md. The current Explosion rule in ReactionRuleDatabase treats it as a two-aspect pair (triggerAspects: [hot, volatile], Adjacent). The new system works differently: iterate each Volatile cell, compute net_hot = sum(Hot magnitudes of cardinal neighbors) - sum(Cold magnitudes of cardinal neighbors). If net_hot > effective_threshold (base 0 + stable_buffer), trigger Explosion. This makes Cold a strategic heat shield near Volatile. Implementation: (1) Change the Explosion rule to be a single-trigger rule (triggerAspects: [volatile] only). You may need to add a new RuleEvaluationType or special-case Volatile evaluation in EvaluateAdjacentRule. (2) For each placed reagent's Volatile cells, get cardinal neighbor cells, sum Hot magnitudes, subtract Cold magnitudes to get net_hot. (3) If net_hot > 0 + stableBuffer, trigger Explosion with affected cells being the Volatile cell and contributing Hot cells. (4) Null-suppressed cells (from R-3) should contribute 0 magnitude. (5) Update or replace existing Explosion tests. Add new tests: Volatile with Hot neighbor (explodes), Volatile with Hot+Cold balanced (net_hot=0, safe), Volatile with more Hot than Cold (explodes), Cold as heat shield (1 Hot + 1 Cold adjacent = safe), Volatile with no Hot neighbors (safe), Stable buffer raises effective threshold.

tasks.title: Contiguous boundary utility
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Highlight/ContiguousBoundary.cs -- a static utility that computes which edges of each cell in a group form the outer boundary (for non-obstructive highlight rendering). Method: Compute(IReadOnlyCollection<Vector2I> cellPositions) returns Dictionary<Vector2I, CellEdge>. Algorithm: for each cell in the set, check 4 cardinal neighbors. If a neighbor is NOT in the set, that direction's edge is a boundary edge. Single cell = all 4 edges. 2x2 block = only outer 8 edges (no internal cross). L-shape = outer boundary only. Empty set = empty result. This is reusable for bag border rendering and highlight regions. MUST have zero Godot dependencies. Add unit tests: single cell (All edges), 2x2 block (no internal edges), L-shape boundary correct, empty set returns empty, disjoint cells each get All edges, horizontal strip gets top+bottom on middle cells.

tasks.title: HintEngine core logic (auto-pick, dislodge, execute)
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/HintEngine.cs as a static class. Methods: (1) GetSolutionPlacement(PuzzleState state, int reagentIndex) -> Placement? -- looks up state.Solution for matching ReagentIndex, returns null if not found. (2) ComputeDislodgeList(MetaGrid grid, List<Reagent> reagents, Reagent targetReagent, Placement solutionPlacement) -> List<int> -- compute target positions from solution placement (set target rotation, call GetMetaGridPositions), for each position check grid cell occupancy, collect unique occupying reagent indices excluding the target itself. If any occupying reagent IsLocked, include a flag or return special value indicating blocked. (3) PickNextHintTarget(PuzzleState state, HintState hintState, List<Reagent> reagents) -> int? -- auto-pick: first scan for unplaced reagents whose index is in HintedReagentIndices (snap-back candidates, free), return first found. If none, scan for first unplaced reagent whose index is NOT in HintedReagentIndices (new hint, costs budget). Return null if all placed. (4) ExecuteHint(MetaGrid grid, List<Reagent> reagents, int reagentIndex, Placement solutionPlacement) -> HintResult -- if target is currently placed, call grid.RemoveReagent(target). For each reagent in dislodge list: grid.RemoveReagent(), reset Rotation=0, set IsHinted=false. Set target Rotation to solution rotation. Call grid.PlaceReagent(target, solutionPosition). Set target.IsHinted=true. Return success with dislodge list. Does NOT mutate HintState (caller handles budget). Write 14 unit tests: solution lookup valid/invalid, dislodge empty/occupied/locked-blocker/self-exclusion, auto-pick snap-back-priority/new-hint/all-placed, execute placement/dislodge/IsHinted-flag/rotation-set.

tasks.title: Create docs/puzzle-design.md
tasks.description: Create docs/puzzle-design.md as a comprehensive puzzle type reference across all tiers. Sections: (1) Design Philosophy: binary pass/fail is the Sudoku model for Simple complexity; optimization adds depth for higher tiers; secondary scoring (time + hints, NEVER move count) adds replayability; never punish placement/removal experimentation. (2) Tier Definitions: MVP (currently shipping), Post-MVP (concrete designs as PuzzleType variants), Aspirational (same tier as item protrusion, requires new infrastructure), DLC/Expansion (pie-in-the-sky). (3) Current Puzzle Types (MVP): FitAllSafely (implemented), MaximizeValue (enum exists, not evaluated), MeetRequirement (enum exists, not evaluated). (4) Post-MVP Optimization Puzzle Types: BalanceToNeutral (target net-zero for aspect pair, score=abs distance, par provided), MinimizeSeverity (all reagents placed, unavoidable reactions, minimize total severity, par=minimum achievable), MaximizeWithConstraints (oversized reagent set, limited space, score=total value placed), TimedChallenge (FitAllSafely with visible timer, star thresholds). (5) Scoring & Stars: 3-star system per puzzle, Star1=completion, Star2=efficiency (0 hints), Star3=speed (under par time). Par times: Easy=90s, Medium=150s, Hard=240s. Timer starts on first selection, pauses on help/primer, stops on confirm. (6) Aspirational - Destruction & Transmutation: destruction (reactions remove reagents, deliberate explosions), transmutation (combine reagents into new ones), forced explosion (win condition IS triggering reaction). Tier marker: same as protrusion, needs new infrastructure. (7) DLC/Expansion - Actual Alchemy: alembic container, brewing (multi-step process), potion output. Tier marker: 'Errands for an Alchemist, not Actual Alchemist Simulator.' Requires new game mode on top of puzzle engine.
